name: 100% Natural Healing Skin Cream Vasel
description:
Are you struggling with dry lips, cracked heels, skin rashes, itching or weather-damaged skin?

Try BioT’s VaseL- a 100% natural, petroleum-free skin protectant made from three powerful earth ingredients: Coconut Oil, Beeswax, and Aloe Vera, blended in the ideal ratio to nourish, protect, and repair even the most sensitive skin. BioT’s VaseL is fully natural healing cream, deeply healing, and lab-tested at Bio.T Laboratoires, Bengaluru.

What Actually Causes Dry, Damaged, Irritated Skin?

Most skin problems like dryness, cracked heels, chapped lips, rashes, or itching happen when your skin barrier breaks down. Weather extremes, pollution, hot/cold air, cosmetics, and fungal/bacterial exposure all weaken the natural oil–moisture balance of the skin.   

When the barrier is damaged, your skin loses moisture quickly and becomes vulnerable to:

  • Cracks, flakes, and peeling
  • Itching and discomfort
  • Fungal outbreaks (like ringworm)
  • Slow wound healing
  • Sensitivity to pollution and temperature changes
  • Increased irritation and redness That is exactly what our three natural ingredients are designed to do.
